TOKYO NIGHT DARK / VLC

TRY IT
Double-click Try-TRON.cmd beside TRON.vlt.
It starts a separate VLC window with the skin, without saving changes to
your VLC preferences. You can also drop a media file onto the launcher.

MAKE IT YOUR DEFAULT
1. Keep TRON.vlt somewhere permanent.
2. In your regular VLC window, open Tools > Preferences > Interface.
3. Select Use custom skin and choose TRON.vlt.
4. Save, fully quit VLC, and reopen it.

MUSIC FEATURES
Audio > Equalizer / Bass Boost opens VLC's ten-band equalizer and preamp.
Start with Preamp at 0 dB or below before raising the bass bands.
Drop music onto Try-TRON-Music.cmd to try the themed projectM effects.
Keep the included visualizations folder beside the launcher.
For normal VLC use, set Preferences > All > Audio > Visualizations > projectM
preset path to that folder, save and restart, then select
Audio > Audio Options > Visualizations > projectM. Select Disable to turn off.
See docs/audio.md for single-preset selection, customization, timed playlists,
and the limits of DJ mixing in VLC.

CONTROLS
Top bar: Media, Playback, Audio, Video, Subtitles, Tools, View, Help,
the full VLC menu, minimize, maximize/restore, close.
The top labels open working menus; Help shows keyboard shortcuts.
Subtitles opens VLC's full menu. With a video loaded, choose Subtitle
to add a subtitle file or select a subtitle track. VLC's skin commands
do not expose a dedicated subtitle popup; the full menu provides access.
Track settings become available when the relevant media is loaded.
Bottom row: open, play/pause, previous, next, stop, shuffle, loop playlist,
show/hide playlist, mute, volume, fullscreen.
Seek by clicking or dragging the blue seek bar while playing seekable media.
The blue slider controls volume. Hover for the percentage.
Drag the title bar to move; double-click it to maximize or restore.
Resize from the right edge, bottom edge,
or larger lower-right grip on either the player or playlist window.
Skins2 does not provide top/left edge resize actions.
The playlist has add, remove-selected, and save buttons plus a scrollbar.
Double-click a playlist entry to play it.
In fullscreen, use F or Esc to leave; use I or the middle mouse button to
toggle the matching fullscreen controller. Space toggles play/pause.
Right-click the player background or use the top-right three-dot button
to reach VLC's normal menu, including audio, subtitles and preferences.

RETURN TO THE STANDARD INTERFACE
Open Preferences from the VLC menu, select Use native style, save,
then quit and reopen VLC. Trying the launcher alone does not change
your saved default interface.

NOTES
Designed for VLC 3.0.23 on Windows with the Skins2 interface.
The VLT itself should also work with Linux VLC builds that include Skins2;
Linux has not been tested. Select the VLT in VLC's Interface preferences.
Try-TRON.cmd is Windows-only. No launcher is needed on Linux.
The main window starts at 960 x 644 and can be resized or maximized.
The minimum size is 800 x 470. This is a bitmap skin: controls keep their
pixel size when resizing and may look small on high-density displays.
VLC's file pickers, context menus and preferences retain VLC/system styling;
a skin controls the player, playlist and fullscreen controller.
The menu row is provided by the skin and exposes VLC's supported actions;
it is not a copy of every command in VLC's native interface menu bar.
Custom VLC skins are not supported on macOS.

Original layout and icons created for this skin.
TRON styling adapted from the original Tokyo Night VLC project.
Original Tokyo Night palette by enkia / Tokyo Night contributors:
https://github.com/tokyo-night/tokyo-night-vscode-theme
Skin format documentation:
https://images.videolan.org/vlc/skins2-create.html
The skin uses VLC's installed default font and includes no external fonts.
